  w=torch.zeros(Z.shape[1],requires_grad=True); b=torch.zeros(1,requires_grad=True)
  opt=torch.optim.LBFGS([w,b],max_iter=300)
  def cl():
    opt.zero_grad(); l=torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(Z[tr]@w+b,y[tr])+1e-4*(w**2).sum(); l.backward(); return l
  opt.step(cl)

  for th in [0,1,2]:

    print(L,th,round(float(rec),3),round(float(ff),4))
